_doc: Spirit beast companions (BEAST-001, Beasts system). A character who practises the Beast Tamer profession (any rank) and defeats an enemy listed as a beast's `enemy` may tame it: chance = tame.base_chance + tame.chance_per_rank * Beast Tamer rank, capped at tame.max_chance (min_rank: lowest Beast Tamer rank that may try). Each attempt gives tame.xp Beast Tamer xp. A character keeps at most max_companions beasts. Each companion adds its `bonuses` (fractions of the master's combat stats: max_hp, attack, defense, speed), scaled by (1 + rank_scale * Beast Tamer rank) and by outgrown_scale ^ (master's realm - the beast's enemy realm) once the master outgrows it, so stronger beasts stay useful longer.

beasts.name: Fields Boar
beasts.description: A stubborn boar that now charges at your enemies instead of you.

beasts.name: Mist Wolf
beasts.description: A grey wolf that fades into fog and bites from where the enemy is not looking.

beasts.name: Stone Ape
beasts.description: A granite-hided ape that takes blows meant for its master.

beasts.name: Cloud Eagle
beasts.description: A spirit eagle that dives from the clouds at your foes.

beasts.name: Flame-Tailed Fox
beasts.description: A sly three-tailed fox that sets the air ablaze around your enemies.

beasts.name: Jade-Scaled Python
beasts.description: An ancient serpent whose coils turn aside blades.

beasts.name: Thunderwing Roc
beasts.description: A storm-riding roc. Lightning answers its cry.
